race.description: Mba Wealth Solutions Gold Circle Hcp (C1)
race.comment: CHAMBER OF SECRETS (5) didn't fire a shot last time in after enjoying such a promising debut prep last spring. Has trialled well leading into this and will take plenty of beating if she's got things back on track. FEARN TRICK (2) also returns and did score first-up when last in work at Scone over 1400m. Lines up for the first time for the Ross Lomax stable. A solid return is anticipated. BUSHWALKER (7) returns and has run well fresh without winning. Hasn't won for a long time but has good form littered through. Not underestimating. ELDERBERRY WINE (9) strips rock-hard fit and is ticking along nicely. Has been kept fresh for this and is among the chances.
